description: This file defines the KpiSaveController class, a PHP controller responsible for handling KPI save operations within the OrangeHRM Performance module. It sets up Vue.js components based on request attributes, either for editing an existing KPI or creating a new one with default ratings.

classes.name: KpiSaveController
classes.description: Controller that manages the creation and editing of KPIs within the OrangeHRM performance module, utilizing Vue.js components for the frontend interface.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component for KPI creation or editing based on the request attributes.
